The '''1954-55 Serie A''' was the fifty-third edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]]. It was the twenty-second Italian Football Championship [[brand]]ed [[Serie A]], since Serie A was launched in [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]]. This was the twenty-ninth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[AC Milan]] were champions for the second of four wins that decade, and for the fifth time in their [[history]]. This was their second scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]], and their second win contested as Serie A.

==Teams==
[[Catania Calcio|Catania]] and [[Aurora Pro Patria 1919|Pro Patria]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

On February 13, 1955 [[Inter Milan]], [[Juventus FC|Juventus]], [[A.S. Roma|Roma]] and [[AC Milan|Milan]] all lost on the same match day, a feat that would not be repeated until September 18, 2022.
